title: The Water That Wouldn't Stay Still
intro: This quiz follows Mira and Jay as they learn about evaporation, condensation, sublimation, and boiling.

choices: Water vapor changes into liquid
Liquid water changes into water vapor at the surface
Ice changes directly into liquid
Water freezes into ice
questions.explanation: During evaporation, liquid water changes into water vapor at the surface.

choices: Water vapor cooling and changing into liquid droplets
Liquid water changing into gas
Ice melting into water
Water boiling rapidly
questions.explanation: Condensation is when water vapor cools and changes into liquid droplets.

questions.prompt: What happened to the frost in the story?
choices: It melted into a puddle first
It changed directly from solid ice into water vapor
It became rain
It froze into thicker ice
questions.explanation: The frost changed directly from solid ice into water vapor.

choices: A liquid changing into a solid
A gas changing into a liquid
A solid changing directly into a gas
A liquid changing into a gas only at boiling point
questions.explanation: Sublimation is when a solid changes directly into a gas.

questions.prompt: How is boiling different from evaporation?
choices: Boiling happens throughout the liquid, while evaporation happens only at the surface
Evaporation is faster than boiling
Boiling can happen at any temperature
Evaporation creates bubbles throughout the water
questions.explanation: Boiling happens throughout the liquid, while evaporation happens only at the surface.
